'transform',\r\n\t\tlabel,\r\n\t\tlabelZh,\r\n\t\tchannels: [ 'opacity', 'offsetX', 'offsetY', 'scale', 'rotateX', 'rotateY', 'rotateZ' ],\r\n\t\t// Only the channels v1 actually used start enabled \xe2\x80?the rest are opt-in.\r\n\t\tdefaultChannels: { opacity: true, offsetX: false, offsetY: true, scale: true, rotateX: false, rotateY: false, rotateZ: true },\r\n\t\tselector: true,\r\n\t\tdefaultDuration: 0.8,\r\n\t\thintZh: 'From\xe2\x86\x92To \xe9\x80\x90\xe5\xad\x97\xe8\xbf\x87\xe6\xb8\xa1\xef\xbc\x9b\xe8\x8c\x83\xe5\x9b?\xe9\xa1\xba\xe5\xba\x8f/\xe9\x94\x99\xe5\xbc\x80\xe5\x86\xb3\xe5\xae\x9a\xe6\xaf\x8f\xe5\xad\x97\xe8\xb5\xb7\xe5\xa7\x8b\xe6\x97\xb6\xe9\x97\xb4\xe3\x80?,\r\n\t\tparams: {\r\n\t\t\topacity: pair( 'Opacity', '\xe9\x80\x8f\xe6\x98\x8e\xe5\xba?, defs.opacity[ 0 ], defs.opacity[ 1 ], 0, 1, 0.01 ),\r\n\t\t\toffsetX: pair( 'Offset X', '\xe5\x81\x8f\xe7\xa7\xbbX', defs.offsetX[ 0 ], defs.offsetX[ 1 ], - 500, 500, 1, 'px' ),\r\n\t\t\toffsetY: pair( 'Offset Y', '\xe5\x81\x8f\xe7\xa7\xbbY', defs.offsetY[ 0 ], defs.offsetY[ 1 ], - 500, 500, 1, 'px' ),\r\n\t\t\tscale: pair( 'Scale', '\xe7\xbc\xa9\xe6\x94\xbe', defs.scale[ 0 ], defs.scale[ 1 ], 0, 4, 0.01 ),\r\n\t\t\trotateX: pair( 'Rotate X', '\xe6\x97\x8b\xe8\xbd\xacX', defs.rotateX[ 0 ], ),\r\n\t\t\trotateZ: pair( 'Rotate Z', '\xe6\x97\x8b\xe8\xbd\xacZ', defs.rotateZ[ 0 ], defs.rotateZ[ 1 ], - 6.2832, 6.2832, 0.01, 'rad' ),\r\n\t\t},\r\n\t\tsample( ctx, pose ) {\r\n\r\n\t\t\tconst P = ctx.params;\r\n\t\t\tconst on = ctx.on;\r\n\t\t\tconst u = ctx.p;\r\n\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.opacity ) pose.opacity *= clamp01( lerp( P.opacity[ 0 ], P.opacity[ 1 ], u ) );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.offsetX ) pose.offsetX += lerp( P.offsetX[ 0 ], P.offsetX[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.offsetY ) pose.offsetY += lerp( P.offsetY[ 0 ], P.offsetY[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.rotateX ) pose.rotateX += lerp( P.rotateX[ 0 ], P.rotateX[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.rotateY ) pose.rotateY += lerp( P.rotateY[ 0 ], P.rotateY[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.rotateZ ) pose.rotateZ += lerp( P.rotateZ[ 0 ], P.rotateZ[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\tif ( on.scale ) {\r\n\r\n\t\t\t\tconst s = lerp( P.scale[ 0 ], P.scale[ 1 ], u );\r\n\t\t\t\tpose.scaleX *= s;\r\n\t\t\t\tpose.scaleY *= s;\r\n\r\n\t\t\t}\r\n\r\n\t\t},\r\n\t};\r\n\r\n}\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'charIn', charStepDescriptor( 'charIn', 'Char In', '\xe9\x80\x90\xe5\xad\x97\xe5\x85\xa5\xe5\x9c\xba', {\r\n\topacity: [ 0, 1 ],\r\n\toffsetX: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\toffsetY: [ - 36, 0 ],\r\n\tscale: [ 0.55, 1 ],\r\n\trotateX: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\trotateY: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\trotateZ: [ - 0.35, 0 ],\r\n} ) );\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'charOut', charStepDescriptor( 'charOut', 'Char Out', '\xe9\x80\x90\xe5\xad\x97\xe5\x87\xba\xe5\x9c\xba', {\r\n\topacity: [ 1, 0 ],\r\n\toffsetX: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\toffsetY: [ 36, 0 ],\r\n\tscale: [ 1, 0.55 ],\r\n\trotateX: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\trotateY: [ 0, 0 ],\r\n\trotateZ: [ 0.35, 0 ],\r\n} ) );\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'wave', {\r\n\tscope: 'char',\r\n\tgroup: 'motion',\r\n\tlabel: 'Wave',\r\n\tlabelZh: '\xe6\xb3\xa2\xe6\xb5\xaa',\r\n\tchannels: [ 'offsetY', 'offsetX' ],\r\n\tdefaultChannels: { offsetY: true, offsetX: false },\r\n\tselector: true,\r\n\tdefaultDuration: 1,\r\n\tdefaultLoop: 'infinite',\r\n\thintZh: '\xe4\xb8\x80\xe7\x9b\xb4\xe8\xbf\x90\xe8\xa1\x8c\xef\xbc\x9bduration \xe5\x8f\xaa\xe6\x8e\xa7\xe5\x88\xb6\xe6\x8c\xaf\xe5\xb9\x85\xe4\xbb\x8e ramp \xe8\xb5\xb7\xe6\x8c\xaf\xe5\x88\xb0\xe6\xbb\xa1\xe9\x87\x8f\xe7\x9a\x84\xe6\x97\xb6\xe9\x97\xb4\xe3\x80?,\r\n\tparams: {\r\n\t\tamp: Object.assign( {}, NUM_OFFSET, { default: 12, min: 0, max: 400, label: 'Amp Y', labelZh: '\xe6\x8c\xaf\xe5\xb9\x85Y' } ),\r\n\t\tampX: Object.assign( {}, NUM_OFFSET, { default: 0, min: 0, max: 400, label: 'Amp X', labelZh: '\xe6\x8c\xaf\xe5\xb9\x85X' } ),\r\n\t\tfreq: { type: 'number', default: 1.25, min: 0, max: 8, step: 0.05, label: 'Frequency', labelZh: '\xe9\xa2\x91\xe7\x8e\x87' },\r\n\t\tspeed: { type: 'number', default: 1, min: - 4, max: 4, step: 0.05, label: 'Speed', labelZh: '\xe9\x80\x9f\xe5\xba\xa6' },\r\n\t\tphase: { type: 'number', default: 0, min: - 12.566, max: 12.566, step: 0.1, label: 'Phase', labelZh: '\xe5\x88\x9d\xe7\x9b\xb8\xe4\xbd? },\r\n\t\tramp: { type: 'number', default: 0.35, min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.05, label: 'Ramp in', labelZh: '\xe8\xb5\xb7\xe6\x8c\xaf\xe5\xb9? },\r\n\t},\r\n\tsample( ctx, pose ) {\r\n\r\n\t\tconst P = ctx.params;\r\n\t\tconst g = P.ramp + ( 1 - P.ramp ) * ctx.p;\r\n\t\tif ( g === 0 ) return;\r\n\t\tconst ph = ctx.charIndex * P.freq + P.phase + ctx.t * Math.PI * 2 * P.speed;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.offsetY ) pose.offsetY += Math.sin( ph ) * P.amp * g;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.offsetX ) pose.offsetX += Math.cos( ph ) * P.ampX * g;\r\n\r\n\t},\r\n} );\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- bend\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'bend', {\r\n\tscope: 'char',\r\n\tgroup: 'motion',\r\n\tlabel: 'Bend',\r\n\tlabelZh: '\xe5\xbc\xaf\xe6\x9b\xb2',\r\n\tchannels: [ 'rotateZ', 'offsetY' ],\r\n\tdefaultChannels: { rotateZ: true, offsetY: true },\r\n\tselector: true,\r\n\tdefaultDuration: 1,\r\n\thintZh: '\xe6\x8c\x89\xe5\xad\x97\xe5\x9c\xa8\xe6\x95\xb4\xe8\xa1\x8c\xe4\xb8\xad\xe7\x9a\x84\xe5\xbd\x92\xe4\xb8\x80\xe5\x8c\x96\xe4\xbd\x8d\xe7\xbd\xae\xe5\xbc\xaf\xe6\x9b\xb2\xef\xbc\x9blift \xe6\x8e\xa7\xe5\x88\xb6\xe4\xb8\xa4\xe7\xab\xaf\xe4\xb8\x8a\xe7\xbf\x98\xe9\x87\x8f\xe3\x80?,\r\n\tparams: {\r\n\t\tamount: { type: 'number', default: 0.15, min: - 3.14, max: 3.14, step: 0.01, unit: 'rad', label: 'Amount', labelZh: '\xe5\xbc\xaf\xe6\x9b\xb2\xe9\x87? },\r\n\t\tlift: { type: 'number', default: 20, min: - 200, max: 200, step: 1, unit: 'px', label: 'Lift', labelZh: '\xe7\xab\xaf\xe9\x83\xa8\xe6\x8a\xac\xe5\x8d\x87' },\r\n\t},\r\n\tsample( ctx, pose ) {\r\n\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.charCount <= 1 ) return;\r\n\t\tconst P = ctx.params;\r\n\t\tconst mid = ( ctx.charCount - 1 ) * 0.5;\r\n\t\tconst nrm = ( ctx.charIndex - mid ) / Math.max( mid, 1 );\r\n\t\tconst k = nrm * ctx.p;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.rotateZ ) pose.rotateZ += k * P.amount;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.offsetY ) pose.offsetY += nrm * k * P.lift;\r\n\r\n\t},\r\n} );\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- jitter\r\n\r\nfunction hash01( x ) {\r\n\r\n\tconst s = Math.sin( x * 12.9898 ) * 43758.5453;\r\n\treturn s - Math.floor( s );\r\n\r\n}\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'jitter', {\r\n\tscope: 'char',\r\n\tgroup: 'motion',\r\n\tlabel: 'Jitter',\r\n\tlabelZh: '\xe6\x8a\x96\xe5\x8a\xa8',\r\n\tchannels: [ 'offsetX', 'offsetY', 'rotateZ' ],\r\n\tdefaultChannels: { offsetX: true, offsetY: true, rotateZ: false },\r\n\tselector: true,\r\n\tdefaultDuration: 1,\r\n\tdefaultLoop: 'infinite',\r\n\thintZh: '\xe6\x8c\x89\xe5\xad\x97\xe5\x99\xaa\xe6\xb3\xa2\xe6\x8a\x96\xe5\x8a\xa8\xef\xbc\x9bseed \xe5\x86\xb3\xe5\xae\x9a\xe5\x9b\xbe\xe6\xa1\x88\xef\xbc\x8cspeed \xe5\x86\xb3\xe5\xae\x9a\xe5\xa4\x8d\xe7\x94\xa8\xe9\xa2\x91\xe7\x8e\x87\xe3\x80?,\r\n\tparams: {\r\n\t\tampX: { type: 'number', default: 4, min: 0, max: 200, step: 0.5, unit: 'px', label: 'Amp X', labelZh: '\xe6\x8a\x96\xe5\x8a\xa8X' },\r\n\t\tampY: { type: 'number', default: 4, min: 0, max: 200, step: 0.5, unit: 'px', label: 'Amp Y', labelZh: '\xe6\x8a\x96\xe5\x8a\xa8Y' },\r\n\t\trotate: { type: 'number', default: 0.05, min: 0, max: 1.5, step: 0.01, unit: 'rad', label: 'Rotate', labelZh: '\xe6\x97\x8b\xe8\xbd\xac\xe6\x8a\x96\xe5\x8a\xa8' },\r\n\t\tspeed: { type: 'number', default: 12, min: 0, max: 60, step: 0.5, label: 'Speed', labelZh: '\xe9\x80\x9f\xe5\xba\xa6' },\r\n\t\tseed: { type: 'number', default: 1, min: 0, max: 9999, step: 1, label: 'Seed', labelZh: '\xe7\xa7\x8d\xe5\xad\x90' },\r\n\t},\r\n\tsample( ctx, pose ) {\r\n\r\n\t\tconst P = ctx.params;\r\n\t\tconst g = ctx.p;\r\n\t\tif ( g === 0 ) return;\r\n\t\tconst base = ctx.t * P.speed + ctx.charIndex * 1.7 + P.seed * 13.13;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.offsetX ) pose.offsetX += ( hash01( base ) * 2 - 1 ) * P.ampX * g;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.offsetY ) pose.offsetY += ( hash01( base + 37.7 ) * 2 - 1 ) * P.ampY * g;\r\n\t\tif ( ctx.on.rotateZ ) pose.rotateZ += ( hash01( base + 91.3 ) * 2 - 1 ) * P.rotate * g;\r\n\r\n\t},\r\n} );\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- typewriter\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'typewriter', {\r\n\tscope: 'char',\r\n\tgroup: 1,\r\n\thintZh: '\xe6\x8c?selector \xe9\xa1\xba\xe5\xba\x8f\xe7\xa1\xac\xe5\x88\x87\xe6\x98\xbe\xe7\xa4\xba\xef\xbc\x9bfade>0 ( ctx.raw > 0 ? 1 : 0 ) : clamp01( ctx.raw / fade );\r\n\t\tpose.opacity *= a;\r\n\r\n\t},\r\n} );\r\n\r\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- wipeReveal (text pass)\r\n\r\nregisterTextAnim( 'wipeReveal', {\r\n\tscope: 'text',\r\n\tgroup: 'reveal',\r\n\tlabel: 'Wipe reveal',\r\n\tlabelZh: '\xe6\x89\xab\xe5\x85\x89',\r\n\tdefaultDuration: 1,\r\n\t// v1 semantics: the sweep owns visibility, otherwise a per-char fade sits on\r\n\t// top of it and the blade reads as a muddy fade-in.\r\n\tdefaultSuppressCharPose: true,\r\n\thintZh: '\xe6\x95\xb4\xe6\x96\x87\xe7\x89\x87\xe5\x85\x83\xe6\x89\xab\xe5\x85\x89 + \xe5\x88\x83\xe5\x85\x89\xef\xbc\x88\xe8\xb5\xb0 TextLayerRT\xef\xbc\x8c\xe4\xb8\x8d\xe6\x98\xaf\xe9\x80\x90\xe5\xad\x97\xe9\x80\x8f\xe6\x98\x8e\xe5\xba\xa6\xef\xbc\x89\xe3\x80?,\r\n\tparams: {\r\n\t\tdirection: {\r\n\t\t\ttype: 'select',\r\n\t\t\toptions: WIPE_DIRS,\r\n\t\t\tdefault: 'ltr',\r\n\t\t\tlabel: 'Direction',\r\n\t\t\tlabelZh: '\xe6\x96\xb9\xe5\x90\x91',\r\n\t\t\toptionLabelsZh: { ltr: '\xe5\xb7\xa6\xe2\x86\x92\xe5\x8f?, rtl: '\xe5\x8f\xb3\xe2\x86\x92\xe5\xb7?, ttb: '\xe4\xb8\x8a\xe2\x86\x92\xe4\xb8?, btt: '\xe4\xb8\x8b\xe2\x86\x92\xe4\xb8? },\r\n\t\t},\r\n\t\tsoft: { type: 'number', default: 0.08, min: 0, max: 0.5, step: 0.01, label: 'Soft', labelZh: '\xe8\xbd\xaf\xe8\xbe\xb9' },\r\n\t\tedgeIntensity: { type: 'number', default: 2.5, min: 0, max: 8, step: 0.1, label: 'Edge', labelZh: '\xe5\x88\x83\xe5\x85\x89\xe5\xbc\xba\xe5\xba\xa6' },\r\n\t\tedgeWidth: { type: 'number', default: 0.03, min: 0.005, max: 0.25, step: 0.005, label: 'Edge width', labelZh: '\xe5\x88\x83\xe5\x85\x89\xe5\xae\xbd\xe5\xba\xa6' },\r\n\t\tblendMode: {\r\n\t\t\ttype: 'select',\r\n\t\t\toptions: WIPE_BLENDS,\r\n\t\t\tdefault: 'normal',\r\n\t\t\tlabel: 'Blend',\r\n\t\t\tlabelZh: '\xe6\xb7\xb7\xe5\x90\x88\xe6\xa8\xa1\xe5\xbc\x8f',\r\n\t\t\toptionLabelsZh: { normal: '\xe6\xad\xa3\xe5\xb8\xb8', add: '\xe5\x8f\xa0\xe5\x8a\xa0', screen: '\xe6\xbb\xa4\xe8\x89\xb2', multiply: '\xe6\xad\xa3\xe7\x89\x87\xe5\x8f\xa0\xe5\xba\x95' },\r\n\t\t},\r\n\t\tinvert: { type: 'bool', default: false, label: 'Invert', labelZh: '\xe5\x8f\x8d\xe5\x90\x91\xef\xbc\x88\xe5\x87\xba\xe5\x9c\xba\xef\xbc\x89' },\r\n\t},\r\n\tresolvePass( ctx ) {\r\n\r\n\t\tconst P = ctx.params;\r\n\t\tlet progress = clamp01( ctx.raw );\r\n\t\tif ( P.invert ) progress = 1 - progress;\r\n\t\treturn {\r\n\t\t\tkind: 'wipe',\r\n\t\t\tcomponentId: ctx.comp ? ctx.comp.id : '',\r\n\t\t\tprogress,\r\n\t\t\tdirection: WIPE_DIRS.includes( P.direction ) ? P.direction : 'ltr',\r\n\t\t\tsoft: Math.max( 0.02, Math.min( 0.45, P.soft ) ),\r\n\t\t\tedgeIntensity: Math.max( 0, P.edgeIntensity ),\r\n\t\t\tedgeWidth: Math.max( 0.005, Math.min( 0.25, P.edgeWidth ) ),\r\n\t\t\tblendMode: WIPE_BLENDS.includes( P.blendMode ) ? P.blendMode : 'normal',\r\n\t\t};\r\n\r\n\t},\r\n} );\r\n\r\nexport { EASES };\r\n"
